purpose: Deep-library RNA-seq quantification completion for a Tartary buckwheat transcriptomics study: 26 public SRA runs (SRR19049440/41/43/44/45, SRR22699505-516, SRR24322339-353 subset) that the study's legacy pipeline had not computed were quantified end-to-end through the public CLI (SRA pull, fasterq-dump, salmon 2.7.0 with the study's exact parameters). Every quant.sf carries the full 33,955-transcript ID set. The batch also validated production resilience: a scheduled host reboot mid-batch triggered an automatic resume 20 seconds after boot, and the batch finished without manual intervention.

methodology.repeat_flag: 1 per run, serial batch, completed runs skipped on resume
methodology.disclosure: no legacy output exists for these runs by construction (they are the runs the legacy pipeline had not computed); correctness rests on the bit-exact parity established in bench-20260914-003/004 plus full ID-set checks; the first four runs shared the HDD data volume with a concurrent analysis workload

environment.cpu_model: Intel Xeon E5-2676 v3 @ 2.40GHz (24 threads; runs pinned to cores 8-15, nice 10)
environment.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP (Polaris 20, amdgpu kernel driver; unused by these workloads)
environment.memory: 32 GiB DDR3-1600 MT/s (2x16 GiB DIMM_B1/D1, 72-bit width)
environment.storage: system/log: Kingston SA400S37 120 GB SSD; benchmark I/O data volume: WDC WD5000AZLX 500 GB 7200rpm HDD; bulk reference data: Seagate ST3000DM001 3 TB HDD
environment.code_revision: v1.0.3 release binary (workstation deployment, built 2026-09-14) + post-release ops scripts

data_sources.note: same index as every quantification in this study

data_sources.reference: NCBI SRA runs SRR19049440-45, SRR22699505-516, SRR24322339-353 (subset), Tartary buckwheat transcriptomics; staged from the study's NAS authoritative copies
